description: Plan 3 — Frontend, Admin API & Dashboard. Closes the launch blockers carried out of Plans 1-2, gives the emailed quote link a real page, and builds the internal dashboard behind Cloudflare Access.

complexity.reasoning: 8 functional requirements x2, 3 integration points x3 (Turnstile, Cloudflare Access, D1), 4 ui components x1.5, 1 database change x2, 2 external APIs x3 => 39/5 = 7.8

baseline.note: Plan 2 complete at 0f9efaf. Suite must never regress below this and must stay warning-free.

prerequisites.title: QUOTE_LINK_SIGNING_KEY in 1Password
prerequisites.blocks: every /api/* route at runtime (503 until set)

prerequisites.title: Resend sender domain SPF/DKIM verified
prerequisites.action: add DNS records for the sender domain in Resend
prerequisites.blocks: email delivery only; failures visible as quote_email_failed events

prerequisites.title: Move unodigit.com.au nameservers to Cloudflare
prerequisites.action: move DNS from OnlyDomains to Cloudflare, then add the Worker Custom Domain and two Access applications
prerequisites.blocks: US-004 through US-008. Cloudflare Access cannot front a workers.dev hostname, so the admin API cannot be protected as spec section 12 requires until the zone moves. Do NOT substitute a bearer secret or allowlisted header.

userStories.title: Turnstile and per-IP rate limiting on /api/chat
userStories.description: As the business, I want the chat endpoint guarded, because MAX_TOTAL_TURNS caps one session and not how many sessions an attacker opens — today DeepSeek spend is unmetered.
acceptanceCriteria: A first message with no turnstile token is rejected 403 and makes ZERO LLM calls (assert the fetch spy)
Turnstile is required only on the first turn, not every turn
Exceeding MAX_TURNS_PER_IP_PER_DAY returns 429 and makes ZERO LLM calls
The turn is recorded BEFORE the model call, so a provider outage still consumes quota
Raw IP is never stored; every rate_limit ip_hash is 64 hex chars
Mutation-checked: moving recordTurn after the LLM call, and returning 403 instead of 429, each fail a distinct test

userStories.title: Commit the BA bot widget
userStories.description: As the deployed site, I need the widget in git — it is untracked, CI builds from a fresh checkout, so production currently ships with no widget at all.
acceptanceCriteria: components/BaBot/ (5 files) committed
Every key in the committed .env files is NEXT_PUBLIC_*; the Turnstile value is the site key (public half)
git check-ignore confirms the .gitignore negations actually re-include the env files
pnpm build --force succeeds and emits apps/web/out (--force defeats a Turbo cache hit that would mask a compile failure)
CLAUDE.md is NOT committed — it carries the user's own in-progress edit
userStories.notes: No Worker tests change; apps/web has no suite, so pnpm build is the gate.

userStories.title: Public quote page /q/ (static shell, query params)
userStories.description: As a client following an emailed link, I want to read my quote — the page does not exist, so every link sent today 404s.
acceptanceCriteria: Page lives at app/q/page.tsx and reads BOTH id and sig from useSearchParams — NOT a dynamic /q/[id] route, which static export cannot pre-render
useSearchParams is wrapped in Suspense or the static export build fails
Renders quotes.markdown verbatim; does not re-derive or re-format it
A 403 renders 'this link is not valid' and never distinguishes unknown-id from bad-signature
A missing id or sig renders the same failure state without calling the Worker
pnpm build --force succeeds and emits apps/web/out/q/
userStories.notes: Link shape is effectively permanent — links already emailed cannot be reissued.

userStories.title: Cloudflare Access JWT verification
userStories.description: As the admin API, I want requests authenticated by verifying the Access JWT, because protecting only the Pages route leaves the data open to anyone who knows the Worker URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Verifies the JWT SIGNATURE against the Access public keys, not merely the header's presence
Checks aud against the application AUD tag, so a JWT for another app in the same team is rejected
Checks exp
JWKS cached in KV with a TTL, not fetched per request
Middleware mounted on /admin/* only; public chat endpoints stay unauthenticated
No JWT library added — WebCrypto RS256
Mutation-checked: removing signature verification fails a test

userStories.title: Admin read API
userStories.description: As sales, I want to read leads, conversations, briefs, quotes, funnel and costs through an authenticated API.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /admin/leads paginated (default 50) — an unbounded scan is a latent outage
GET /admin/conversation/:id returns transcript, slots per turn, off-topic flags
GET /admin/brief/:conversationId and /admin/quote/:id return stored markdown
GET /admin/funnel groups by abandoned_at_state
GET /admin/costs returns tokens and cost per conversation plus a rolling total
CSV export quotes fields containing commas or quotes
Every route sits behind the US-004 middleware

userStories.title: DELETE /admin/lead/:id — Privacy Act deletion path
userStories.description: As a data subject, I want my personal information deleted on request, as spec section 8 requires.
acceptanceCriteria: Deletion cascades to conversations, messages, events, briefs and quotes — a retained transcript still contains what the visitor typed
rate_limit rows are NOT deleted (salted hashes, not personal information; clearing them hands an abuser a reset button)
The deletion is logged as an event without retaining what was deleted
Unknown lead returns 404 (already behind Access, so enumeration is not a concern here)
Tests query EACH dependent table to prove the cascade, not merely that the endpoint returned 200
userStories.notes: Spec section 8 writes /api/lead/:id but section 12 requires /admin/* — the prefix rule wins, since Access matches on path.

userStories.title: Dashboard — leads and conversation views
userStories.description: As sales, I want a leads table and a conversation detail view.
acceptanceCriteria: app/admin/ renders a sortable, paginated leads table
Conversation view shows transcript, slots per turn and off-topic flags
Uses globals.css design tokens — no hardcoded hex, size, radius or duration
Follows the existing server/client component split
pnpm build --force succeeds

userStories.title: Dashboard — brief, quote, funnel, costs, export
userStories.description: As sales, I want the artifacts and the funnel and cost views, plus CSV export.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders briefs.markdown and quotes.markdown verbatim
Funnel view shows drop-off by abandoned_at_state
Costs view shows tokens and cost per conversation and a rolling total
CSV download works
pnpm build --force succeeds

userStories.title: Settle the remaining placeholders
userStories.description: As the business, I want the uncalibrated numbers settled before a real client sees a quote.
acceptanceCriteria: TASKS_PER_WEEK calibrated — it is a delivery commitment, it sets the 'roughly N weeks' line the client reads
src/estimator/calibration.ts replaced with real claw-forge plan output, not plausible placeholders
below_floor added as a column plus migration, removing the idempotent re-read's re-derivation, BEFORE MINIMUM_ENGAGEMENT_AUD next changes
userStories.notes: Decision task, not purely code. RATE_PER_TASK_AUD settled at 25 on 2026-08-19.
